gloss: broad daylight; the middle of the day

definitions.gloss: broad daylight; the middle of the day
definitions.explanation: The bright middle hours of the day. Characteristically used in contexts where something surprising, shocking, or bold happens despite the clear visibility of daytime — crimes committed in public view, hallucinations occurring when one should be lucid, etc.

examples.japanese: {白昼|はくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧。
examples.english: A crime committed in broad daylight.

examples.japanese: {白昼|はくちゅう}、⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: An incident occurred in broad daylight, in the middle of town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白昼|はくちゅう}⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}し{入|い}った→押し入る：06760_oshiiru⟧。
examples.english: The criminal brazenly broke into the bank in broad daylight.

examples.japanese: ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧{白昼|はくちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{幽霊|ゆうれい}→幽霊：10648_yuurei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、⟦{信|しん}じられない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
examples.english: Seeing a ghost in broad daylight like this is an unbelievable story.

notes:
Compound of {白|はく} ('white; bright') and {昼|ちゅう} ('daytime'). A slightly literary word meaning 'bright daytime.' Almost always carries the nuance of 'even though it's the middle of the day (and people can see),' rather than neutrally referring to the afternoon.

USAGE:
Most commonly appears in crime and scandal reporting: {白昼|はくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧ ('crime committed in broad daylight'). The adverbial form {白昼|はくちゅう}⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ ('brazenly, in broad daylight') is a fixed expression emphasizing the shameless boldness of an act. For neutral reference to the middle of the day, ⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧ or ⟦{日中|にっちゅう}→日中：03519_nicchuu⟧ is more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白昼|はくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧: crime committed in broad daylight
- {白昼|はくちゅう}⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: brazenly, in broad daylight
- {白昼|はくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧: an incident in broad daylight
- {白昼|はくちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧: to occur in broad daylight
- {白昼夢|はくちゅうむ}: daydream; waking dream

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧: daytime — plain, everyday word; no dramatic nuance
- ⟦{日中|にっちゅう}→日中：03519_nicchuu⟧: during the day; daylight hours — neutral, common in weather and schedule contexts
- ⟦{真昼|まひる}→真昼：18020_mahiru⟧: high noon; midday — the bright middle of the day, more poetic
- {白日|はくじつ}: the bright sun; open day — very literary; appears in {白日|はくじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ('out in the open')

REGISTER:
Slightly literary and written. In everyday speech, {真昼間|まっぴるま} ('in the middle of the day') conveys a similar 'despite being daytime' nuance more colloquially.
